settings.heading: You shouldn’t have to take a supplement on trust.
settings.sub: Supplements don’t have to prove much to go on sale in the UK. So we built MUTO to a higher bar, and we show you all of it.

settings.text: Made in the UK to GMP
Six scientists on our advisory board

settings.heading: Doing everything right, and still buying on a leap of faith.
settings.body:
Most of the people I’ve worked with in their 40s and 50s were doing everything right. Training, eating well, taking their supplements. And they still felt it: gone by 3pm, nothing left for the people at home, sitting out the things they love.

Most of what they took, they took on trust. Greens, a supermarket multivitamin, collagen, joint capsules. Labels that didn’t show the doses. Nobody checking every batch. No way to know if any of it was doing anything.

settings.label: Why I built MUTO
settings.quote: I spent years in the lab studying why our bodies get less back from the same food and training as we age. Then years consulting people just like you. So when I built MUTO, I built it the way I’d want it built for my own family: nothing hidden, everything checkable.
settings.name: Dr Richie Barclay, Founder

settings.heading: Nobody made us do any of this. That’s the point.
settings.body: Food supplements in the UK are regulated as food. That keeps them safe to eat, but it asks for far less than most people assume. Here’s the gap.

settings.rows:
Approval before it goes on sale | ✕ No | ✓ Formulated by a PhD cell biologist and reviewed by a six-member scientific advisory board
Every dose on the label | ✕ No: “proprietary blends” are allowed | ✓ Every ingredient, every dose, on the label and on this page
Independent testing of every batch | ✕ No | ✓ Every batch third-party tested. Certificates available on request
Made in a GMP-certified facility | ✕ No | ✓ Made in the UK to GMP standards, in an ISO-certified facility
A scientist involved | ✕ No | ✓ A PhD founder and six named scientists
Human research | ✕ No | ✓ Our first human study starts in December 2026, with more university research to follow
A guarantee | ✕ No | ✓ 90 days, or your money back

settings.heading: Ten standards. All of them checkable.
settings.body: Each one is a plain promise, why it matters, and how you can check it yourself.

settings.title: Every dose on the label
settings.body: No proprietary blends. Every one of the 19 ingredients is listed with its exact dose and form, so you know exactly what you’re taking.
settings.answer: Read the full label below, or turn the jar round.

settings.title: Doses chosen for a reason
settings.body: NR at 300mg, the most allowed in Great Britain. Vitamin D3 at 2,000 IU. B vitamins in their active, methylated forms. Zinc and copper dosed as a pair, because they compete for absorption. Nothing added just to make the list longer.
settings.answer: Every dose and form is in the ingredient table.

settings.title: Only ingredients authorised in the UK
settings.body: Every ingredient in MUTO is authorised for use in UK food supplements. That’s why we use NR rather than NMN, which is still under assessment.

settings.title: Every batch third-party tested
settings.body: Not just the first batch. Every batch is tested by an independent lab before it’s released.

settings.title: Made in the UK, to GMP
settings.body: Manufactured in the UK to GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) standards, in an ISO-certified facility.

settings.title: Nothing you don’t need
settings.body: Vegan capsules made from plant cellulose (HPMC). Vitamin D3 from algae. No major allergens, no fillers, no caffeine and no stimulants.

settings.title: Scientists with names
settings.body: Formulated by Dr Richie Barclay, PhD in cell biology and nutrition, with a six-member scientific advisory board across sports nutrition, exercise physiology, public health and lifestyle medicine. The board meets every quarter to guide our research and every new formula.

settings.title: Research we’ll publish, whatever it shows
settings.body: MUTO is part of independent university research: a University of Westminster study starts in December 2026, with work at King’s College London, Coventry and Newcastle to follow. There are no results yet, and we’ll never say there are.
settings.answer: We’ll share every update on this page.

settings.title: Honest claims only
settings.body: We only make the health claims UK law authorises, worded exactly. We’ll tell you what MUTO won’t do as clearly as what it will. Every review is genuine and invited from every customer, and every creator we work with is disclosed.
settings.answer: Every claim on our site carries its authorised wording.

settings.title: Built to be checked
settings.body: Note how you feel today: score your afternoons, or check your wearable. Give it 90 days. If you don’t feel the difference, you get every subscription payment back. Skip, pause or cancel online anytime, with a reminder five days before every payment.

settings.heading: The foundation your body runs on.
settings.body: Built for what you actually need in your 40s and 50s. Five jobs, one jar.

settings.rows:
1. Energy | Methylated B vitamins | Help you feel less tired
2. Muscles and bones | Vitamin D3 2,000 IU + K2 100µg | Normal muscle function and the maintenance of normal bones
3. Immunity | Zinc 15mg + copper 1mg, with D3 | The normal function of your immune system
4. NAD+ | NR 300mg | Your body turns it into NAD+, which runs lower as we get older
5. What ties it together | CoQ10 150mg, trans-resveratrol 50mg, grape seed extract 150mg, PQQ 20mg, TMG 450mg, BioPerine® 5mg | Every dose on the label
settings.note: Vitamins B6 and B12 contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Vitamin D contributes to normal muscle function. Vitamins D and K contribute to the maintenance of normal bones. Zinc, copper and vitamin D contribute to the normal function of the immune system.

settings.q: Is MUTO tested for banned substances?
settings.a: Every batch of MUTO is third-party tested. We don’t currently make a banned-substance certification claim, and we’ll update this page if that changes.

settings.q: Can I see your test results?
settings.a: Yes. Batch certificates are available on request: hello@mutolongevity.com.
NR is authorised for food supplements in Great Britain, at up to 300mg a day for adults. NMN is still under novel food assessment. We only use ingredients that are authorised in the UK.

No, and we won’t say it has. Our first human study starts in December 2026 at the University of Westminster. We’ll publish the results, whatever they show.
It won’t make you 25 again, replace sleep, training or a decent diet, or work overnight. It isn’t a stimulant. It’s a daily foundation, and most people give it 60 to 90 days.

Check with your GP or pharmacist first if you take any prescription medicine. MUTO contains vitamin K2, which can affect blood thinners such as warfarin. We’re happy to send the full label to share with your doctor.
